_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Buying with unsettled proceeds and selling again before settlement is a good-faith violation. Read live at 00:53 ET, before the morning settlement ran - the unsettled figure is what the broker reported at that moment, not a forecast of what clears.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Not armed. AMD printed 8/4 after the bell and the extended-hours tape is DOWN, not up - bid 478.41 against a 518.58 official close. There is no strong reaction to continue, so the setup this slot was waiting on did not appear. Re-read at the real open; an after-hours bid is not an opening print.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader. The leader gapped down instead, so there is no upside chain to find a laggard in. A sympathy read off a red leader is just catching the same knife one name over.

This is the branch the tape currently points to: roughly -7.7% after hours on the print. A one-position account cannot survive catching it wrong. Let the flush finish and let the open establish a real price before anything is proposed.
